name: Hold ‘Em Down (Combat, Teamwork)
body:
Prerequisite(s): Improved Unarmed Strike

Benefit(s): Whenever an ally who also has this feat successfully grapples a creature you threaten, you can spend an immediate action to also make a grapple attempt against that opponent.
